description: A WinForms WebView2 opens target-blank links in a separate Edge/WebView window instead of staying inside the app, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/66191200/how-to-prevent-webview2edge-based-to-open-a-new-window.
prompt: In my WinForms app, links inside the embedded browser can open a new window outside my form. I want either to block those popups or keep them inside the same embedded browser, not launch a separate window.
